profile.name: Luminos电动俯仰轴
profile.description: 这是一种用于精密定位平台的电动俯仰旋转轴，常见于多轴光学对准或光子器件耦合系统中。它可对样品、光纤、透镜或其他光学元件进行细微倾角调节，并支持回零、绝对/相对移动及微步控制，适合实验室中的高精度角度对准任务。
profile.description_en: This is a motorized pitch rotation axis for precision positioning stages, commonly used in multi-axis optical alignment or photonics coupling systems. It provides fine tilt adjustment of samples, fibers, lenses, or other optical components, and supports homing, absolute/relative motion, and microstepping for high-precision angular alignment in the lab.
